item.title: Mark Cuban helps heart transplant survivor access drug after insurer stops covering it
item.description: At 11, Payton Herres received a donated heart after years of health problems caused by Ebstein’s anomaly. Fifteen years later, she faced a fight to access everolimus, the anti-rejection medicine she had relied on since 2013. After her insurer stopped covering the drug and its cost rose sharply, Herres turned to social media. Her story went viral and reached Mark Cuban, whose pharmacy began supplying the medicine at a lower cost. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Streaming site pulls Chainsmoker Cat series in Hong Kong for breach of ad rules
item.description: A Taiwan-based streaming platform has removed the Japanese anime series Chainsmoker Cat for Hong Kong audiences because the programme is in breach of the city’s ban on online smoking advertisements. Animation Crazy, a streaming platform launched by Bahamut, a Taiwanese internet forum and news website, said on Monday that it recently received a letter from the Hong Kong’s Department of Health concerning Chainsmoker Cat. The show’s content contravened rules that prohibited advertising smoking... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: La mayor amenaza medieval para el Papa nació en un remoto pueblo aragonés. Gobernó desde Peñíscola hasta que lo envenenaron
item.description: En el año 2000, un cráneo parcialmente momificado apareció en un palacio de Sabiñán, en Zaragoza. Los análisis lo identificaron como los restos de un papa del siglo XV. Alguien lo había robado de la urna donde reposaba. La Guardia Civil lo recuperó meses después, el 12 de septiembre . El cráneo lleva décadas generando un pleito judicial entre tres localidades —Illueca, Sabiñán y Peñíscola— que reclaman su custodia.
